task.title: Creating a repository by using the API
task.shortdesc: To create an image repository in Red Hat Quay, you can use the API.

ul.li: You have Created an OAuth access token.

step.cmd: Enter the following command to create a repository using the POST /api/v1/repository endpoint:

info.codeblock: $ curl -X POST \ -H "Authorization: Bearer <bearer_token>" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "repository": "<new_repository_name>", "visibility": "<private>", "description": "<This is a description of the new repository>." }' \ "https://quay-server.example.com/api/v1/repository"
